records.title: [项目自荐] 元形：旧截图与新 HTML 共用的 AI 原型工作台
records.description: 元形，AI 时代的 Axure。复用旧产品截图和 HTML，用自然语言设计本次改动，在流程画布与完整原型间切换，导出单文件交给同事体验。免费开源。

records.title: 【开源自荐】Anselm：一句话让 AI 搭建并持久运行工作流的本地桌面应用
records.description: Anselm is a local-first agentic workflow platform. Describe what you need and the AI creates the functions, agents, and workflows, schedules them, and runs them durably on your own machine with SQLite, approvals, and full run history.
